title: Hamada Operations Platform
description: An end-to-end fleet attendance and logistics management system for PT Hamada Global Jaya, featuring a robust Laravel REST API backend and an offline-first Flutter mobile application.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content: PT Hamada Global Jaya required a system to manage complex logistics operations, track fleet activities, and monitor field employee attendance. Field drivers often operate in remote areas with zero connectivity, leading to data loss and inaccurate tracking with their legacy systems.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content:
We built a two-part solution: a secure administrative portal and an offline-first mobile application.

### Key Architectural Decisions:
1. **Laravel Backend**: Utilized Laravel Sanctum for cross-platform JWT authentication and built RESTful APIs with an indexed, cached MySQL database.
2. **Flutter Mobile App**: Developed a cross-platform mobile app featuring QR code validation and GPS-based location tracking.
3. **Offline-First Synchronization**: Implemented Sembast local database in Flutter. The app caches data offline and automatically synchronizes with the server in the background once connectivity is restored.
4. **Automated Workflows**: Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to trigger real-time push notifications for preventive vehicle maintenance approvals.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: The new system eliminated data loss during field deliveries and provided a centralized dashboard for real-time logistics oversight.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **Zero Data Loss** via offline-first syncing
- **Automated Tracking** using QR and GPS integration
- **Responsive Admin Portal** built with modern web technologies
- **Seamless Authentication** across mobile and web platforms
